annotations.title: Get a hardware interview practice problem

description: Gets one hardware interview practice problem by its id: the task, the module's name and ports, an example, three written hints from a nudge to the approach, and the starting point (an empty module, or for find-the-bug problems a starting test). The answer and the hidden test are not included. Returns the problem and its page link, where it can also be tried against a clock. Free, with no daily limit.

id.description: The problem's id, such as "gray-code-converter", as in breadboardhub.com/practice/<id>.
